title: THE ANGULAR-MOMENTUM FATE -- the infall's spin (S4: geometrically available, kinematically undeposited, f = 0.09): where did it go? (1) the budget's candidate sinks: (a) the orbital halo's per-tracer j from the G209 outer bins, (b) the tidal quadrupole capacity, (c) the merger/accretion (parent-sample) j; (2) the test: the S4 machinery extended outward -- the outer-shell [1,5] R500 v_los gradient and the per-bin map; (3) the consequence: deposited where expected, or a genuine discrepancy; (4) verdicts V1/V2/V3.

upstream.S4: core measured j = 1.540e+04 +- 1.191e+04 kpc.km/s (f = 0.091, UL 0.23); the negative inner beta read as mild tangential anisotropy, not ordered spin
upstream.G182: infall: v_ff = 2 sigma_ph = 242.88 km/s, caustic sigma_d = v_ff/sqrt(3) = 140.23 km/s, j_infall = 1.7001e+05 kpc.km/s at 1 R500
upstream.G209: outer-bin beta profile E2 PRIMARY (1.5-2: 0.285 +- 0.092; 2-3: 0.256 +- 0.066; 3-5: 0.545 +- 0.071) + E1 cross-check; the Jeans machinery and the committed HeCS members
upstream.G137: turnaround reservoir R_ta/R500 ~ 6.15 (6.11-6.17 per cluster); cosmic-reservoir ratio ~ x2.4 M500
upstream.G103: free dust collisionless forever: no viscosity to concentrate or erase the deposit; the phase-mixing is the only redistribution

b_tidal_quadrupole.verdict: SUBSIDIARY, not the sink (3.6% of the missing at the t_H one-way upper bound; net ~0 under adiabatic precession)

part3_consequence.statement: DEPOSITED WHERE EXPECTED: the infall's spin lives in the outer halo's per-cluster ordered kinematics (j_outer-class = 1.3-2.2e5 kpc.km/s at 2-5 R500, bracketing j_infall), the core isotropy the static equilibrium's signature; the original S4 'undeposited' reading is resolved by the outward extension of the measurement.

verdicts.V1: THE BUDGET'S CANDIDATE SINKS: (a) orbital halo -- per-tracer orbital j = 3.4-7x j_infall from the G209 outer bins (amplitude-sufficing; the caustic-deposit radius r_dep = sqrt(3) R500 = 1.73 where the measured f jumps); (b) tidal conversion -- the phantom's quadrupole capacity = 3.6% of the missing at the t_H upper bound (e_N = 0.7): SUBSIDIARY, not the sink; (c) merger/accretion -- the parent budget = 6.2x j_infall at R_ta (~24x LSS bulk): the delocalization register.
verdicts.V2: THE OUTER-J MEASUREMENT: j_outer = 6.654e+04 +- 2.337e+04 kpc.km/s ([1,5) shell, f = 0.39 +- 0.14); per-bin f = 0.06 +- 0.16 (1-1.5), 0.10 +- 0.21 (1.5-2), 0.76 +- 0.19 (2-3, z = 4.0), 1.27 +- 0.32 (3-5, z = 4.0); axes uniform, net stack ~0 by construction of 58 random infall orientations.
verdicts.V3: THE INFALL'S ANGULAR MOMENTUM IS DEPOSITED IN THE OUTER HALO AT j_outer-class = 1.29e+05-2.17e+05 kpc.km/s -- the 2-3 and 3-5 R500 shells' per-cluster ordered kinematics carry f = 0.76 +- 0.19 and 1.27 +- 0.32 of j_infall, bracketing the missing 91% = 1.55e+05; the deposit materializes at r_dep = sqrt(3) R500 as the caustic geometry predicts; the core's isotropy is the static equilibrium's signature (G081), closing S4's open thread.  The number that closes it: f_core + f_outer([1,5)) = 0.48 +- 0.15, and per-bin f_core + f(2-3) = 0.85 / f_core + f(3-5) = 1.36 -- the outer shells ALONE cover the missing 91%.  Honest caveats registered: per-cluster amplitude statistic (net stack ~0 by the projection's orientation averaging -- not a missing deposit), streaming-vs-rotation degeneracy (both are the envelope's j-carrying kinematics), the 6-shell trials factor (2-3/3-5 stay >~3 sigma), the tidal channel capacity-subsidiary (3.6% at the t_H bound); the residual, if any is demanded, sits in the parent sample's own 6.2x angular-momentum budget.

checks.name: C3 [budget (a)] every outer bin's orbital specific j exceeds the infall's by >= 3x (E2 primary, E1 cross-check)
checks.reading: the outer orbits' per-tracer tangential angular momentum is 3.4-7.0x the infall's specific j: in INTENSITY the outer halo can carry the deposit; the coherence question is the gradient measurement's (PART 2).

checks.name: C4 [budget (b)] the tidal quadrupole capacity is < 10% of the missing j (the t_H upper bound; not the primary sink)
checks.reading: the external LSS tide at the turnaround is field-comparable (e_N ~ 0.7, the balance radius) but the DIFFERENTIAL across the phantom is only 2.6%: even over a Hubble time the quadrupole response can exchange ~5.6e3 kpc.km/s of specific j -- 3.6% of the missing 91%, and the exchange oscillates under precession: SUBSIDIARY at best, not the sink (registered).

checks.name: C5 [budget (c)] the environment's specific-j budget >= 5x the missing 91%
checks.reading: the G137 turnaround reservoir carries 6.2x the infall's specific j at the same kinematics; the LSS bulk a further ~24x: the accretion channel is the DELOCALIZATION register -- capable of absorbing the whole residual.

checks.reading: the 2-3 R500 shell alone carries f = 0.76 +- 0.19 of j_infall (the full deposit at z = 4.0); the 3-5 shell carries 1.27 +- 0.32 (z = 4.0): the missing 91% is ACCOUNTED FOR in the outer halo's per-cluster ordered kinematics at the infall's own amplitude class.

checks.reading: the deposit is measured in the outer halo at the infall's own amplitude class: the missing 91% sits inside (at or below) the measured 2-3 and 3-5 shell bands; the core's null is the static equilibrium's signature.
